name: How does local SEO differ from standard SEO for businesses in a city like Chicago?
description: Local SEO targets customers in specific areas like Chicago using localized keywords and Google My Business, unlike standard SEO's broader focus.

mainEntity.name: How does local SEO differ from standard SEO for businesses in a city like Chicago?

acceptedAnswer.text: Local SEO focuses on optimizing your online presence to attract customers within a specific geographic area, which is vital for businesses in cities like Chicago. Unlike standard SEO, which aims for broader national or international visibility, local SEO emphasizes local keywords, Google My Business optimization, local citations (NAP listings), and localized content. The goal is to rank highly in local search results and map packs when users search for services or products 'near me' or 'in Chicago.' This directly connects local consumers with local businesses, driving foot traffic and local conversions.
acceptedAnswer.description: Local SEO targets customers in specific areas like Chicago using localized keywords and Google My Business, unlike standard SEO's broader focus.
